Anna Maria and Brian Clement interview Elaine Gibson, who reversed stage-four cancer decades ago by adopting the Hippocrates lifestyle. She discusses how belief, curiosity, community, and simple daily practices—green juicing, oxygenating movement, meditation, clean food, saunas and targeted therapies—helped her recover and stay well.

Elaine shares practical steps, the emotional and spiritual work that supported her healing, and how she now helps other courageous, health-conscious women create lifestyles that prevent and reverse disease.
